title: storedTrackerAttachments
responsibility: Turns a flag request into the two stored attachment fields, and reads one stored document back after checking its hash.

inputs.name: storedTrackerAttachments.value
inputs.description: The 1 to 4 attachments sent with a flag, each a listing with optional markdown and images; null or undefined clears both fields.

inputs.name: readTrackerAttachment.stored
inputs.type: { attachments?: string | null; attachment_docs?: string | null }
inputs.description: The item fields holding the listing JSON and the compressed documents.

inputs.name: readTrackerAttachment.id
inputs.description: The listing id, which is the SHA-256 of the stored document.

outputs.name: storedTrackerAttachments
outputs.type: { attachments: string | null; attachment_docs: string | null; }
outputs.description: The listing as JSON and a JSON map from id to gzip base64 document; each is null when there is nothing to store.

outputs.name: readTrackerAttachment
outputs.description: The listing with its markdown and images, or null when it is missing, oversized or fails its hash.

errors.name: TrackerItemRequestError
errors.description: storedTrackerAttachments throws a Tracker item error for a wrong count, invalid entry, size limit breach or a spec or doc without text.
